question: Is the AppCompat 1.7.1 source contract plus Robolectric and exact-head Testbox coverage sufficient for the API 31/33 locale-lifecycle boundary, or must representative device/emulator proof be added before merge?
rationale: The code path and automated coverage are strong, but the PR explicitly leaves the user-visible platform lifecycle unobserved; accepting that residual compatibility risk requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Require lifecycle proof
options.body: Hold merge until redacted API 31 and API 33 device or representative emulator evidence shows language changes refresh retained UI, cold services, and foreground notifications.

options.title: Accept automated evidence
options.body: Approve based on direct AppCompat source inspection, Robolectric coverage, Testbox tests, lint, and assembly while explicitly accepting the remaining platform-lifecycle uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require lifecycle proof
recommendation.body: Hold merge until redacted API 31 and API 33 device or representative emulator evidence shows language changes refresh retained UI, cold services, and foreground notifications.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to this feature owner, who authored the canonical issue and exact locale-runtime implementation and is best positioned to provide or sponsor the missing proof.
